# Summary

[summary]: #summary

At most four sentences: what changed, and what a reviewer should look at first.

# Motivation

[motivation]: #motivation

What problem does this solve, and why now?

# Drawbacks

[drawbacks]: #drawbacks

What are the costs or risks of merging this?

# Prior art

[prior-art]: #prior-art

How have similar problems been solved elsewhere — what worked, what didn't?

# Evidence

[evidence]: #evidence

Optional, and strongly recommended for any change a user can see: screens, copy, layout or states. Add screenshots, a screen recording, or other proof such as a test run or a before and after. Drag the files into this box so GitHub hosts them, and link a long log in a comment. Use fake data only: no real keys, tokens or personal data, and no file paths from your machine. Delete this section if it does not apply.

# Notes

[notes]: #notes

One line per fact: `Closes #n`, the issue whose acceptance criteria this meets; the visual change, or "no visual change"; the tests added; the `apps/fumadocs` pages updated, or "none" and why; any migration, breaking change or merge-order constraint.
